Class Simulation

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.simulation.Simulation
public class Simulation extends Object
Core simulation engine for SwarmForge. Manages the simulation loop, tick processing, and world state. Uses sparse pheromone grid with terrain-aware diffusion. Supports CPU multithreaded fallback when GPU is not available.
Author:
Gemini AI Assistant, Silvère Martin-Michiellot
